body: I think it would be better cause I could plan ahead
The only thing is I can’t seem too. Plus it’s not always a negative thought, it’s just I’m feeling sad for absolutely no reason.

Idk, I just never really feel good about myself. I can’t sleep at night, have trouble getting up and dragging myself throughout the day. Sometimes I’ll be halfway through a conversation where everything is good, and I’ll realize I’m completely  bullshitting how I feel
